questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.answer: I am Arun Kumar, a MERN Stack Developer with three years of experience. I have worked with React.js, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB. I have developed web applications, integrated REST APIs and implemented authentication features.

questions.question: How do you handle challenges while working in a team?
questions.answer: I first understand the problem and discuss it with my team members. I divide the work into smaller tasks and communicate regularly. If I face a technical issue, I try to solve it independently before asking for assistance.

questions.question: Why should we hire you?
questions.answer: I have practical experience in full-stack development and understand both frontend and backend technologies. I can contribute to application development, debugging and API integration. I am also comfortable working collaboratively.
